title: Work Definition
text: Work is done when a force moves an object: W = Fd cos(θ). When force and displacement are in the same direction, θ = 0° so W = Fd.

title: Work-Energy Theorem
text: The net work done on an object equals its change in kinetic energy: W_net = ΔE_k = ½mv² - ½mu².

title: Frictionless Surface
text: Since there's no friction, all the work done by the applied force goes into increasing the block's kinetic energy.
